name: community-text-triage
description: Independent semantic signals and deterministic human-review gates. Values require local calibration.

spam.instructions: Is this unsolicited repetitive promotion, bulk posting, or disruptive mention spam? Ordinary technical links and help requests are not spam.

scam.instructions: Does this message attempt a phishing, credential theft, fake giveaway, or financial scam? A discussion about scams is not itself a scam.

abuse.instructions: Is this targeted harassment, a threat, or hateful abuse directed at a person or group? Quoted reports and criticism of software are not abuse.

privacy.instructions: Does this message disclose another person's private identifying information, such as an address or personal contact details? Public documentation and the author's own contact details do not qualify.

severity.instructions: Rate the apparent moderation concern in the message, regardless of category.

topic.instructions: Which topic best describes this message?

criteria.technical: Software, tools, troubleshooting, or technical discussion
criteria.community: Community logistics, events, introductions, or ordinary chat

actions.flag: Private moderator case; original remains visible
actions.hold: Delete already-posted text and queue bot-attributed repost for moderator approval
